mcqs.question: Which institution received the UGC Letter of Approval to establish a campus in Bengaluru in September 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Birkbeck, University of London received the UGC Letter of Approval for a Bengaluru campus in September 2026. The University Grants Commission issued the approval, while the University of London is a federation of institutions and NEP 2020 is a policy framework.
